mask: pixels farther than dE 12 (CIELAB) from the median cheek skin, grown from the ellipses within 1.4x of them; hair-coloured pixels (dE<16 from the median hair) outside 1.15x of the ellipses are never taken; holes filled, dilated 3 px
fill: per-channel quadratic colour field fitted to the visible face skin (dE<10 inside the face ellipse 510,470,150,105), blended with a 2 px Gaussian edge
